steps.title: Log in with Kite
steps.caption: Sign in on Zerodha's own page. The app only reads holdings and funds, and never places orders.

steps.title: Choose a bucket and horizon
steps.caption: Pick how much to plan for and a profit horizon. Horizons missing from today's list are greyed out.

steps.title: The plan at a glance
steps.caption: Built from today's ranked list and NSE closes. The Basket card shows how the bucket splits across names.

steps.title: Bucket, cash and totals
steps.caption: How much of the bucket is committed at limits, where your cash reaches, and the plan's key numbers.

steps.title: Checks for every candidate
steps.caption: The candidate funnel, then every candidate, pass or fail, with the numbers behind each decision.

steps.title: My past plans
steps.caption: Save plan keeps a snapshot. Every saved plan is listed here.

steps.title: A saved plan
steps.caption: A read-only record of the plan as it was, with the same charts. No Kite calls.

steps.title: Update today's list
steps.caption: Publish each day's ranked list by pasting the JSON from Cowork. It is checked before it goes live.
